description: Re-check up to 5 tokens you hold or watch in one call, on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: each token's 0-100 risk score, level, reason codes, price, liquidity and a fingerprint. Send the fingerprints back as since to get what changed (new risks, owner or authority changes, liquidity or price moves of 10%+) and a short list of alerts. One price for the whole list, made for polling positions on a schedule. Rules-based, not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

since.description: Fingerprints from an earlier call, comma-separated in the same order as tokens (empty for a new token)

tokens.description: Up to 5 chain:address pairs, comma-separated (chains: base, eth, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, solana); a bare address defaults to solana for base58, otherwise base

name: token_watchlist
